title: Standalone components with signal-based inputs and outputs
statement: New components omit `standalone: true` (it is the default) and declare their public surface with `input()`/`input.required()` and `output()`, not `@Input()`/`@Output()` decorators or an enclosing NgModule.
rationale: Signal-based inputs are readable synchronously, compose with `computed()`, and give the compiler a typed, required/optional distinction (`input.required<T>()`); decorator inputs are late-bound, untyped-until-runtime for required-ness, and NgModules add a declaration surface this codebase has already moved away from. Mixing both idioms in one app makes every new file's team style a coin flip and slows review.

good.caption: Signal-based inputs/outputs on a standalone component.

bad.caption: Decorator inputs plus a declaring NgModule.

changelog.summary: Initial rule, grounded in the review-panel component.
